meta.title: Text Driven Video
meta.summary: Combine text, a reusable avatar, and a reusable voice to create a talking-avatar video. Returns an asynchronous generation task and video URL for explainers, training, and personalized messages.

hero.title: Text Driven Video
hero.summary: Combine text, a reusable avatar, and a reusable voice to create a talking-avatar video. Returns an asynchronous generation task and video URL for explainers, training, and personalized messages.

endpoint_summary.summary: Create an avatar video from text and a reusable avatar.

auth_requirements.title: Auth Requirements
items: Authentication is required via Authorization header.

preconditions.title: Preconditions
items: Prepare avatar and voice assets before calling this endpoint.
Requires avatar_asset_id, voice_asset_id, and non-empty text.
Avatar and voice IDs can come from your Media Assets or official public assets.
Also accepts optional duration_seconds, links, clarity, aspect_ratio, and model.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.description: Requested output aspect ratio, for example 16:9 or 9:16.

fields.name: avatar_asset_id
fields.description: Reusable avatar asset ID owned by the current user or listed as an official public asset.

fields.name: clarity
fields.description: Requested output clarity, for example 1080P or 2K.

fields.name: links
fields.description: Optional reference links collected from the Playground form.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Selected generation model label or version from the Playground form.

fields.name: voice_asset_id
fields.description: Reusable voice asset ID owned by the current user or listed as an official public asset.

fields.name: code
fields.description:
response code enums:\
.. 0: ok\
.. 12: invalid input\
.. 1410: invalid model\
.. 1409: paid plan required\
.. 1401: insufficient credits\
.... 1401 ~ 1499 是 media\
.. 1402: asset category mismatch\
.. 1403: voice asset required\
.. 1407: asset locked\
.. 1408: asset expired\
.. 1404: provider error\
.. 1405: provider timeout\
.. 13: unauthenticated\
.. 16: rate limit\
.. 99: server error

examples.title: Examples
examples.request_example:
curl -X POST https://api.medux.io/api/app/v1/generate/video/text_driven \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MEDUX_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"aspect_ratio":"ASPECT_RATIO","avatar_asset_id":"AVATAR_ASSET_ID","clarity":"CLARITY","duration_seconds":1,"links":["https://example.com/reference"],"model":"MODEL","model_id":"MODEL_ID","text":"Hello from Medux","title":"Demo title","voice_asset_id":"VOICE_ASSET_ID"}'
examples.curl_command:
curl -X POST https://api.medux.io/api/app/v1/generate/video/text_driven \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MEDUX_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"aspect_ratio":"ASPECT_RATIO","avatar_asset_id":"AVATAR_ASSET_ID","clarity":"CLARITY","duration_seconds":1,"links":["https://example.com/reference"],"model":"MODEL","model_id":"MODEL_ID","text":"Hello from Medux","title":"Demo title","voice_asset_id":"VOICE_ASSET_ID"}'

fields.value: Welcome to Medux. This clip was generated from text and reusable assets.
